description: This file contains utility functions for applying ELK layout algorithms to graph data, converting between ReactFlow and ELK formats, and selecting algorithms based on graph size and structure.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutOptions
methods.description: Returns default layout options for a specified ELK algorithm.

methods.name: convertNodesToElk
methods.description: Converts ReactFlow nodes to ELK node format, calculating dimensions based on node data.

methods.name: convertEdgesToElk
methods.description: Converts ReactFlow edges to ELK edge format.

methods.name: convertElkToReactFlow
methods.description: Converts ELK graph layout back to ReactFlow node and edge format with updated positions.

methods.name: applyElkLayout
methods.description: Main function to apply ELK layout to nodes and edges, returning positioned nodes.

methods.name: getAvailableAlgorithms
methods.description: Returns a list of available ELK algorithms for selection.

methods.name: isAlgorithmSuitableForLargeGraphs
methods.description: Determines if a given algorithm is suitable for large graphs.

methods.name: getRecommendedAlgorithm
methods.description: Suggests an ELK algorithm based on node and edge count.
